dutyRateBasis: Canada HS 9405.11.00 (electric lighting fittings designed for LED) / 9405.19.00 (other), MFN column, 7%. Canada applies no Section 301 equivalent to these goods - its surtaxes on Chinese imports cover electric vehicles, steel and aluminium - so MFN is the entire stack. The deeper difference from the US is the BASE: this 7% is charged on VALUE FOR DUTY, which is the supplier price, where the US charges its 41.4% (HTS 9405.11.80) on retail. About CA$2.04 a unit against US$40.57.
verdict: Priced at CA$143.99, which converts to $102.85 at the 1.40 planning rate - under the RULE 2 ceiling of $103.49 (median $89.99 x 1.15). After the 2026-09-10 re-map it contributes $72.87/unit on the binding 'prepaid' basis and $27.60 on 'billed', against a $12.00 floor. The billed figure was $11.58 before the re-map, i.e. BELOW the floor; correcting the supplier variant is what moved it clear. Top competitor review count 921, so the category is not locked. The gate is a floor, not a CPA test - $72.87 clears all three measured CPA benchmarks ($31.16-$47.93) and $27.60 clears none of them.
retailNote: Repriced 2026-09-13 from the US-derived price to CA$74.99, just under the CA$75.42 amazon.ca band median rather than at the CA$86.73 ceiling.
